investigation_notes.Scriptblock:
$l = (Get-Process lsass).Id
rundll32.exe C:\Windows\System32\comsvcs.dll, MiniDump $l C:\Windows\Temp\debug_report.log full
investigation_notes.Description: The script obtains the LSASS process ID and invokes rundll32 with comsvcs.dll MiniDump to write a full memory dump to C:\Windows\Temp\debug_report.log, which would capture credential material. Key observations: the command explicitly targets lsass for a full memory dump, it was executed under the user account j.doe on SRV-FILE-02, and there are no indicators in the command that this is a known administrative tool or a system/service account operation. This activity is classified as High Priority because dumping LSASS is a direct credential-access behavior performed by a non-service user with no benign markers or historical justification.
